text:
sasha: Quick idea thread: prototyping a pay-as-you-go 'temporary burst credits' product for Dedicated pools. Customer can buy a time-limited headroom token that increases their pool quota immediately. Need product scope, autoscale semantics, billing events, and ops safety checks before we greenlight an initial pilot. Thoughts?
olivia: Nice. Primary product questions: 1) should buys be regional-only? 2) do we allow multiple concurrent buys per org? 3) UI + API parity for console vs programmatic purchases.
tariq: Runtime constraints: treat buys as ephemeral quota slices. Admission controller needs to accept purchase_id and a token bucket delta. Prewarm path required for >60s buys or large token amounts.
zane: Implementation estimate: reuse quota-slab + admission hooks -> ~1.5w. Prewarm KV priming and autoscaler signals are the trickiest. We should define backout if prewarm fails (refund and notify).
maria: Ops concerns: rate-limit purchases per org to prevent accidental cost spikes and fraud. Need a kill-switch to revoke buys per-org or globally. Draft runbook items: revoke purchase, drain prewarmed nodes, notify customer, escalate on billing disputes.
billing-bot: Billing schema suggestions: emit events: TEMP_BURST_INIT, TEMP_BURST_ACTIVATED, TEMP_BURST_FAILED, TEMP_BURST_CANCELLED. Bill by the second with a 5-minute round-up minimum + fixed activation fee. Include purchase_id on invoice line metadata.
sasha: Proposed MVP acceptance criteria: - API + Console purchase flow - admission honors ephemeral tokens within 5s - prewarm attempts for buys >= 5k tokens or >=120s - refund on prewarm failure + no invoice - billing events in payments topic - ops runbook + kill-switch implemented - pilot with 2 customers
tariq: Add launch metrics: active_temp_buys, refunded_buys, prewarm_fail_rate, admission_latency_during_buys. Also require fallback: if admission can't honor token immediately, place buy in pending state and try prewarm once; fail fast after 30s.
maria: Ops will author the runbook draft and templates for customer comms. We'll also define SLAs for ops response windows for revoked buys.
olivia: I'll write the spec and API schema stub and open a PR by Wed EOD. Ping @billing-bot in the PR to wire event schema. If no major blockers, we gate on runtime prewarm path and billing events. Thanks all :+1:
